Chair, distinguished delegates, it's my pleasure to inform you about the work of the Working Group on the Status and Application of the Five United Nations treaties on Outer Space under agenda item six at the current session of this legal subcommittee. The working group focused on the exchange of views on the implementation of article 11 of the Outer Space Treaty in accordance with its work plan contained in A/79/20 annex two. And in this work plan, the working group continued the exchange of views on the implementation of information sharing on space activities as referred to in article 11 of the Outer Space Treaty continued preparing a template offer to states and intergovernmental organizations as a voluntary tool to submit information to the Secretary General on space activities for international distribution and discussed possible additional tools and practices to enhance the exchange of information in accordance with Article 11 of the Outer Space Treaty and in accordance with its work plan. To enhance the working group discussions, Two documents were prepared in advance of the subcommittee, namely a draft template for submission of information on space activities and the background paper on a potential repository of information submitted under Article 11 of the Outer Space Treaty prepared by the Secretariat at the request of the Working Group. The Working Group used the set of discussion questions proposed by the Chair of the Working Group in an information circular dated 25 March 2026 to structure its work. The discussion of the draft template concluded that there was general agreement on the draft template with a view to finalising it at the next session of the legal subcommittee. We also discussed additional tools and practices to strengthen the sharing of information on space activities, including options contained in the background paper by the Secretariat. and the working group noted that the development of an accessible searchable repository such as that outlined under option B in the above mentioned background paper would be desirable. As an outcome and to avoid duplication and identify gaps in information sharing, the working group requested the chair to engage with relevant subsidiary bodies and with the international mechanisms directly relevant for the information sharing on space activities. The working group also requested the Chair, with the support of the Secretariat, to further consult with permanent observers and other stakeholders on the margins of the 69th session of the Committee and to report to the working group on the outcomes. Furthermore, the Working Group, with a view to finalizing its current work plan, requested the Chair, with the support of the Secretariat, to prepare a substantive draft of the final report to be made available in all official languages of the United Nations for consideration and finalization by the Working Group at the next session. The report of the working group has just been adopted and is contained in document A/AC.105/C.2/Tre/2026/L.1. It is my pleasure to submit the report to the subcommittee for its action.
